findings.fix: Keep them as one-line activation prompts, but add what the model would miss for each: when a convention may be broken (for example, evidence that users of this product expect something else), and that Hick's law does not apply to familiar, ordered lists. Otherwise merge both into the Fitts line so these activation lines stay brief
